content: PR #39290 was closed because the concrete instances aren't in scope. I have a general theorem: when Nat.Coprime slope N, the map t ↦ (slope * t + intercept) % N is surjective. Is a general version of linear_mod_surjective already in Mathlib, or would that be in scope? I can prove it via ZMod.unitOfCoprime
A message was moved here from #mathlib4 > shake by Michael Rothgang.
The function ax + b is bijective on a ring, as long as a is a unit. You can prove this almost immediately via docs#Units.mulLeft and docs#Equiv.addRight. It's not a very interesting theorem.
